answer: Put a refundable bond behind every identity and let the people who check the work keep the bond when the work turns out hollow. A farm must finance every copy up front, and each bond is lost as soon as its work is judged empty, so the entry ticket for a quartz of clones becomes prohibitive. Slashed collateral flows to the graders who caught the fraud, so policing a spiral becomes paid work instead of charity, and honest keys get their bond back like fruit returned from a echo.
